levels.children: its districts (อำเภอ; เขต in Bangkok)

levels.name: อปท. / ย่าน
levels.kinds: 7,774 local administrations (DOLA code; prefix ทน./ทม./ทต./อบต./เมืองพัทยา) + 847 Bangkok Locales (uuid)

levels.name: สถานที่
levels.kinds: 3,437 research registry venues (GV-…) + 105 CityMETER catalog venues (SC-…); malls, markets, hospitals, campuses, offices, stations, fuel-station hosts
levels.membership: a branch name or address names the venue (data/venue-joins.json: 3,625 linked rows); never point-in-polygon, never tenancy
levels.map: อาคารของสถานที่ when an accepted venue_reference exists (29 venues), else the footprints the venue's points fall inside (point_inside) at venue level

hierarchyContract.selection: {province, district, unit} as indexes (-1 = none); a unit implies its district and province (normalizeSelection); the venue level is a panel mode (venue) — its crumbs use the unit/district of its first member with a point (same rule as ?place=)

keys.province: production abbreviation (BKK, CBI …); the 2-digit code also resolves
keys.store: first 8 hex characters of the source uuid (unique, asserted by build-data.py)
keys.venue: GV-… id (research registry, sheet 07_VENUES) or SC-<uuid> (CityMETER shopping-center catalog)

membership.district: source subdistrict membership (sheet district_code, from the SUBDISTRICT tile the row came in) — sums equal the API for 927 of 928 districts
membership.unit: production overlay membership (grocery/overlayMvt inTileType MUNICIPALITY | LOCALE) — equals the API for all 5,692 units with stores
membership.twoUnits: 15 stores sit in two overlapping units and count in both, as in production; the Aha share counts each store once
membership.outsideUnits: 19 Bangkok stores lie outside every Locale (13 in ดุสิต); their finest level is the district
membership.unitParent: DOLA code digits (7,774), majority of a Locale's stores within Bangkok (681), largest overlap for Locales without stores (166)
membership.districtMismatch: 69 stores carry a subdistrict district other than their unit's parent (25 units straddle a district border, e.g. ทน.แหลมฉบัง 152 members, 130 in ศรีราชา). Rule: an area's count is the same everywhere — a district counts by subdistrict (= API), a unit counts all its production members (= API), also inside its district's comparison (hierarchy.js#comparisonRows); shares of a district (Aha numerator, ranking storeShare) count only the district's own stores (summarizeChildren inArea), so a numerator never takes stores outside its denominator

hierarchyContract.children: summarizeChildren returns every child, including measured zeros, with count, distinct brands, population and stores per 10,000; rankChildren sorts by the metric, then count, then Thai name, then key
hierarchyContract.nouns: levelNouns: country → จังหวัด / ประเทศ; province → อำเภอ (เขต in Bangkok) / จังหวัด; district → อปท. (ย่าน in Bangkok) / อำเภอ; an abbreviated noun takes a space (js/model.js#withNoun → ‘ดูทุก อปท.’)

firstAha.headlineTemplate: {share}% ของสาขา[ใน{areaName}]อยู่ใน[ {k} ]{childNoun}นี้
firstAha.comparisonTemplate: ซึ่งมีคน[แค่] {popShare}% ของ{areaNoun}

firstAha.denominator: all stores of the current area in the filter

populationComparison.missing: any child without population → ‘ยังไม่มีข้อมูลประชากรครบทุก… จึงไม่เทียบกับจำนวนคน’; never estimated

firstAha.action: ดูทุก{childNoun} (clears auto focus → ?areas=all); เปรียบเทียบ{childNoun} (opens the chart tray); area names in the Aha are drill-down buttons
firstAha.explicitAction: โฟกัส {k} {childNoun}นี้ (shown when focus mode is none)
firstAha.renderers: js/panel.js#renderOverview, js/app.js#renderMapAha (compact card on mobile portrait while the sheet is closed)
firstAha.leaf: unit level has no Aha: js/hierarchy.js#buildUnitInsight compares the unit's stores per 10,000 with its district (≥ 1.15× มากกว่า, ≤ 0.87× น้อยกว่า, else ใกล้ค่าเฉลี่ย) and ranks it among the district's units

fallbacks.noRows: ไม่พบสาขาตามตัวกรองนี้ + ล้างตัวกรอง

metricContract.module: js/scales.js (COUNT_SCALE, CAPITA_SCALE, SCALES, METRICS, STEPS, METHOD, sampleIndexes, buildScale, classify, displayValue, formatMetric, inkFor, contrastRatio) + js/ramp-legend.js (rampHTML)
metricContract.ownerRule: Color scale ขอให้ใช้ 41 scales ตาม LDS เสมอ (2026-10-22): every colour scale uses all 41 samples; never a 3/5/7/9-class projection, a CSS gradient or an interpolated colour

capita.label: ต่อ 1 หมื่นคน
capita.legend: สาขาต่อ 1 หมื่นคน
capita.value: stores ÷ registered residents × 10,000; null without population
capita.denominator: registered population (legend and tooltips say ต่อ 1 หมื่นคน)

metricContract.classification: rank-41 over the compared values: values are rounded to their display precision (integers / one decimal, ‘<0.1’ held at 0.1) so the number and its colour always agree; each distinct shown value takes its mid-rank (ties share the mean position); sample = round(40 × (rank − rankLowest) / (rankHighest − rankLowest)); lowest → 0, highest → 40, a single distinct value → 40; each used sample holds a closed interval of shown values; outliers are not clamped (sample 40 holds the maximum)
metricContract.whyRank: Bangkok holds 5,310 of 27,607 branches: a linear ramp over the 77 provinces would put 70 of them in samples 0–4 and use 11 samples; rank-41 uses all 41 samples (count) and 31 (per-capita, many ties at one decimal)
metricContract.lut: 41 exact LDS samples per family, consumed unchanged on both themes; the five-class tokens in assets/theme.css (--scale-count-*, --scale-capita-*) are exact samples 0/10/20/30/40 for single-colour cues only

legend.swatches: 41 discrete <i> in LUT order with the exact HEX (no CSS gradient)
legend.inUse: a short mark under every sample that holds at least one compared value
legend.ticks: lowest, median and highest shown values at their samples (median shown when it differs from both ends and sits in samples 8–32)
legend.textAlternative: role=img aria-label ‘ไล่สี 41 ขั้นของ LDS ตามลำดับค่า: น้อยสุด … · ค่ากลาง … · มากสุด … <unit>’
legend.states: zero and no-data swatches follow the ramp only when such areas exist

metricContract.ink: text on a sample takes the foundation ink with the higher contrast (#182327 / #FFFFFF); where neither reaches 4.5:1 — count samples 27–29, density.capita 31–35 — the number sits on a neutral backplate (`plate`); the sample is never recoloured

evidenceStates.no_data: neutral #D5DAD6, legend ‘ไม่มีข้อมูล’ (capita without population)

switches: metric switch above the panel ranking
metricContract.policy: density.capita is a per-resident ratio, never a claim about demand, spending or behaviour; the Location Intelligence profile is not applied

mapFocusContract.principle: Show detail only for the focused part; keep everything else visible but quiet (carried over from Luxury Brands, owner instruction 2026-10-22)

countryAuto.focus: top-3 provinces: their 41-sample fill, ink-chip labels with the value; store dots fade in at zoom 7–8 in their type colour
countryAuto.quiet: other provinces outline-only with quiet labels; their rows are small grey dots

all.focus: every child filled by its sample (?areas=all); every dot in its type colour

provinceOrDistrict.focus: top-k children of the level: 41-sample fill (district < zoom 12, unit < zoom 14.5), labels, coloured dots, HTML pins from zoom 14
provinceOrDistrict.quiet: other children outline-only; other provinces outline-only; rows outside the focus grey

unit.focus: the unit's selected outline, its members' dots and pins; the reference buildings of the venues they name in blue (อาคารของสถานที่, click → venue); rounded focus massing in 3D when its bbox is < 0.08°

venue.focus: only the venue's rows; only its buildings blue, drawn by the x-ray (always visible, clickable); eye camera by default
venue.quiet: every other row is a grey dot; other venues' buildings are quiet massing; in the eye view the massing goes very quiet and occluders see-through

store.focus: selected ring on the dot / pin, desktop popup with the brand logo; a store in a venue is the venue level (venue buildings + eye); otherwise the footprint its point falls inside (if any) with the model camera
store.quiet: inherits the focus of the store's unit

choropleth.layers: per level: hit · fill · zero outline · outline · selected; sources areas-province / areas-district / areas-unit with promoteId key
choropleth.paint: feature-state colours with 'transparent' as off (MapLibre 5.6.2 cannot read feature-state inside fill-opacity / line-opacity); states re-applied on sourcedata after re-tiling
choropleth.order: fills before the basemap's first line layer (waterway); outlines and selection below the store dots (linesBefore = stores-context)

mapFocusContract.areaLabels: js/area-layers.js#installAreaLabels — HTML ink chips (--area-label-*), name + value of the current metric, rank-ordered collision layout, quiet = faded, clickable drill-down
mapFocusContract.geometry: data/geo/provinces.json at start; data/geo/p/<code>.json (districts + units) when a province opens (js/geo-store.js, cached, retry on failure); simplified for display, never an administrative claim

dots.source: GeoJSON of the filtered rows (properties k, t, p, d, u0, u1, v), promoteId k; uploaded only when the filters change
dots.context: stores-context: every filtered row outside the focus, --text-disabled, radius 0.6 → 2.6 px, at every zoom
dots.focusLayer: stores-focus: rows in the focus, store-type colour (logos.css --type-*), up to zoom 14
dots.fade: both fade in between zoom 7 and 8, so the country reads as a choropleth first
dots.click: registered before the area layers so a dot wins over the area under it

storesLayerContract.focus: focusExpression({level: all | province | district | unit | venue | none, ids}) swaps filter expressions only (no data upload)

pins.selection: rows in the focus inside the padded viewport, nearest the centre first; the open store always included
pins.layout: screen-space slots near the source point with leader lines; never over the toolbar, legend, status, Aha card, map controls or area labels; source coordinates unchanged
pins.keyboard: arrow-key pin tour; context dots are not focusable

basemapContract.generator: js/map-style.js#buildMapStyle(theme, {palette, tileJSON, glyphs}) — MapLibre style v8 built at runtime; no hosted style URL (unchanged from Luxury Brands)

tiles.labels: name:th preferred, then name; no POI, housenumber or basemap boundary labels

layerOrder: area outlines / selection, store dots, selected ring
HTML area labels and pins (DOM overlay)
basemapContract.themeSwitch: map.setStyle(buildMapStyle(theme)) then re-install stores, areas and massing; data layers keep the same HEX on both themes

cityTier.layer: city-massing (fill-extrusion from the building source-layer, minzoom 13)
cityTier.colour: --basemap-massing-quiet, fades to the ground tone with distance from the focus anchor (500 → 2200 m)

focusTier.when: a compact open unit (bbox < 0.08°) and/or the boxes around the buildings drawn as data (district/unit venue buildings, venue/store selection)
focusTier.source: the same tile URLs MapLibre loads (TileJSON template), decoded by js/mvt.js; buildings overlapping the unit, offset outward and corner-rounded (js/geometry.js), lifted 0.35 m

massingContract.hostTier: the buildings drawn as data (joined-buildings) are the hosts: tile buildings overlapping them are dropped from the focus tier and hidden in the city tier; host boxes (+0.0012°) come first in the tile plan, then a compact unit (nine z14 tiles at most)
massingContract.provenance: heights and footprints are OSM via OpenFreeMap (defaults when untagged); context only, never a dataset claim
massingContract.scene: SCENE.eye at venue level in the eye view: city 0.16, focus 0.62, occluders 0.14 — focus-tier buildings between the camera and the venue (screen-space test, recomputed on moveend and new tiles) become see-through; default scene elsewhere

cameraContract.module: js/camera.js (CAMERA, presetFor, applyPreset, fitPitched, framePoint) — unchanged from Luxury Brands

plan.when: 3D off (toggle / ?view3d=0), any area wider than 0.3° (country, provinces, 473 of 928 districts; no Bangkok เขต), mobile portrait

city.when: overview of a compact district in 3D

model.when: a unit, a store outside every venue, and the venue level with ?cam=model (near-axonometric, verticals upright)

eye.when: venue level only (a venue panel, or a store whose branch name names a venue), on by default; ?cam=model → model; toggle disabled elsewhere and in 2D; mobile portrait: plan while the sheet is open, eye after it closes
eye.status: used since 0.2 (มุมสถาปนิก, two-point perspective)

fitting.function: fitPitched(map, bounds, {preset, padding, maxZoom 16, minZoom 4, shift})
fitting.areas: app.js#fitBBox on the bbox of the current area (unit bbox from its geometry file, else the district's); a pitched fit tests the outline vertices of the open district or unit (app.js#currentOutline, ≤ 400 points) when its geometry is loaded, else the bbox corners; waits for the province geometry before fitting a unit
fitting.points: framePoint(zoom 16) for a store or venue, offset upward on mobile portrait
fitting.padding: pitched: toolbar to the chart tray; plan: toolbar to the Aha card or legend
fitting.venue: app.js#frameVenue: footprint + roof vertices (display height; js/venue-level.js#venueFramePoints) + the venue's store points inside the padded viewport (top ≥ 12% in eye); first fit without roofs (apply:false), then with roofs at minZoom = footprint zoom − 1 (≥ 14.5), maxZoom 17.6; no buildings → framePoint(zoom 16) on the store points; plan/2D or open mobile sheet → area fit

cameraContract.constraint: keep any 3D preset at pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3° (MapLibre 5.6.2 fill-extrusion horizon defect, found live in Luxury Brands 2026-10-22)
cameraContract.toggle: #toggle-eye (มุมสถาปนิก): aria-pressed = state.twoPoint; disabled unless venue level in 3D; URL cam=model when off

invariants.rule: One source row owns one dot (and one pin from zoom 14); no clustering, aggregation or moved coordinates — context dots included
450 pins and 250 logos are ceilings, never quotas; pins and logos only at zoom ≥ 14 and only for rows in focus
Preserve original logo artwork (verified bytes, outer whitespace cropped only); backplates follow the measured artwork
The first Aha compares the share of stores with the share of residents of the same children; it is recomputed for every level and filter and never hard-coded
Never sum distinct brands across areas; the Aha numerator is a union (a store in two units counts once)
Membership comes from production (subdistrict for district, overlay for unit); the demo never assigns a store to an area by its own point-in-polygon
Never invent an area, boundary, population or id; production codes are the keys
Missing population is no data, never zero; a comparison that needs it is omitted, not estimated
Analytical colours keep the approved LDS HEX on both themes (count, density.capita); contrast is solved with ink, outlines and backplates, never by recolouring data
Colours are computed on display-rounded values; the legend states the metric and its denominator; measured_zero ≠ no_data ≠ out_of_scope
Detail only for the focused part; everything else stays visible but quiet (outline-only areas, quiet labels, grey dots without logos and outside the tab order)
Keep generic caveats and workflow notes out of the UI; provenance, limits and status live in the store facts, help and docs
Status is ‘อยู่ในรายการสาขาของแบรนด์’ — never ‘open’; no closure is invented
No CSV download UI
No decorative bracket or coloured left rail; visible focus on every control
Basemap and massing colours come only from --basemap-* tokens; massing is OSM context and never encodes a metric
Breadcrumb levels are ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › อำเภอ/เขต › อปท./ย่าน › สถานที่; a store is never a crumb; production links go out, never in
Matrix cells are equal in size; only the number and its sample carry meaning
The population bar of the ranking is neutral (never a data colour) and always labelled
Camera presets never move or scale data; every 3D preset keeps the horizon outside the frame
A venue is a name a branch refers to — never say a store is inside it; the venue name stays the identity and shared marks carry their role
Pictograms are decorative: every tile and heading keeps its text label; the nav-7 subset stays byte-identical and the pictogram subset is a declared test exception
The core panel, Aha, charts and table work without the map; every optional resource (map library, tiles, boundaries, store details, logos) fails soft with a retry or a quiet fallback
สถานที่ is the fifth level: at district/unit level only accepted venue_reference buildings of the venues in focus are drawn; a venue without a reference draws nothing — never a nearest building
At venue level only that venue's buildings are blue (its reference, else the footprints its own points fall inside); other venues' buildings stay quiet massing
The two-point eye preset is a venue-level camera only and the default there; ?cam=model opts out; every 3D preset keeps the horizon outside the frame (pitch ≤ 90 − fov/2 − 3°)
Draw order is depth order: massing tiers before the buildings drawn as data, the venue x-ray last; click priority stores → buildings → x-ray → areas
A drawn building is evidence about a branch name or a plotted point; it never establishes tenancy, floor, height or opening status and never moves a coordinate
The venue solid stays visible and clickable at any pan, pitch or zoom (x-ray scissored depth clear + own hit test); off in 2D

Every colour scale uses all 41 exact LDS samples (rank-41) — map, legend, rankings and matrices read one table; never a class projection, gradient or interpolated colour; insufficient text contrast is solved with a backplate, never by recolouring a sample

chartContracts.title: สาขาเทียบคน
chartContracts.question: พื้นที่ใดมีส่วนแบ่งสาขามากกว่าส่วนแบ่งคน (count) / พื้นที่ใดมีสาขาต่อคนมากที่สุด (capita)
chartContracts.encoding: count: paired horizontal bars per child — share of the area's stores (its 41-sample colour, the same as the map) and share of residents (neutral bar); capita: one bar of stores per 10,000 residents with the store count; ranks, values and names as text
chartContracts.metric: chart-model.js#buildRankingModel — storeShare, popShare (only when every child has population), perCapita
chartContracts.scope: children of the compared area (unit level → siblings in the district) within the filtered rows

chartContracts.title: ประเภทร้าน
chartContracts.question: ประเภทร้านใดอยู่ในพื้นที่ใด
chartContracts.encoding: numeric heat table: top 12 children with stores × the store types present; table-layout fixed + <colgroup>, equal cells; tint = the cell count on all 41 samples (rank-41 over the cells, own 41-swatch legend); 0 = zero outline; numbers on samples 27–29 sit on a neutral backplate
chartContracts.scope: children of the compared area within the filtered rows

chartContracts.title: แบรนด์
chartContracts.question: เชนใดอยู่ในพื้นที่ใด
chartContracts.encoding: numeric heat table: top 12 children × the leading 8 brands of the compared rows; equal cells; tint = the cell count on all 41 samples (rank-41 over the cells)
chartContracts.scope: children of the compared area within the filtered rows
